lines.text: Ava hikes in her favorite cotton hoodie.
On the climb she sweats, and the hoodie soaks it up and stays wet.
At the windy top, she's shivering.
Cotton holds water and loses its warmth when wet.
Here's the fix. Wear a synthetic or wool base layer,
and a fleece as your warm layer.
Fleece keeps much of its warmth when damp and dries fast.
Ava zips up at the top, warm.
Save this before your next cold hike.
